versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Codex Pet — Pro Pack for RunComfy.
- Generate a custom Codex Pet for OpenAI Codex from a single reference image; outputs compatible spritesheet.webp (1536x1872, 8x9 grid) and pet.json manifest.
- Uses RunComfy CLI (runcomfy + magick) with only one OpenAI GPT Image 2 call per pet; no Codex Pro, `$imagegen`, or OPENAI_API_KEY required.
- Produces all 9 Codex Pet animation states programmatically via ImageMagick micro-transforms for subtle, native-style animation.
- Simple install: drop the output into `${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/pets/<name>/` for instant Codex detection.
- Triggers on various "codex pet"-related keywords and supports batch generation.
